article.title: Why Cities Need Green Spaces
article.content: Urban life is convenient, but it can also be stressful and crowded. Parks, riverside paths, and small community gardens help balance city life. Green spaces improve air quality, reduce noise, and lower summer temperatures. They also encourage exercise and social interaction. Research shows that regular contact with nature can reduce anxiety and improve mood. For children, outdoor environments support curiosity and healthy development. Designing greener neighborhoods is not only an environmental decision; it is also a public health investment.
article.translation: 城市生活很便利，但也可能带来拥挤与压力。公园、河边步道和社区小花园能为城市生活带来平衡。绿地可以改善空气质量、降低噪音并缓解夏季高温，还能促进运动和社交。研究表明，规律接触自然有助于减少焦虑、改善情绪。对儿童来说，户外环境也能支持好奇心与健康成长。建设更绿色的社区不仅是环保选择，也是公共健康投资。
